Chapter 741 - 741 Breakthrough; Another Enemy!

Chapter 741 - 741 Breakthrough; Another Enemy!

741 Breakthrough; Another Enemy!

Blood splattered everywhere, and his aura dissipated.

Surrender?

Sorry, no need!

Lin Fan understood the logic of letting the tiger return to the mountain.

He didn’t want any trouble to follow.

Since they wanted to attack him and the Earth, they had to be careful.

Then, death was the best ending!

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Killed a Level 5 Martial Monarch Realm cultivator. Obtained 50 billion experience points.]

Energy surged into his body.

Following that, Lin Fan raised his head slowly and looked over at the dense and uncountable ocean universe army.

This gaze was like the eyes of the Grim Reaper, cold and awe-inspiring.

The warriors of the ocean universe couldn’t help but shiver.

Then, there was a commotion.

” The universe master is dead!”

” Lord universe master!”

“Run!”

“Run!”

Everyone was like a swarm of ants as they turned around and ran into the planet-like spaceship.

However, all of this was just an illusion.

He saw…

Lin Fan raised the True Dragon Sword slowly.

“Ang!”

In the void, a huge golden dragon that broke through the universe suddenly appeared.

The golden dragon roared, and the space shattered.

The sword descended.

“Ang!”

The giant golden dragon bared its fangs and brandished its claws. It swept out an endless and terrifying aura as it roared toward the sea world army and the spaceship.

It was like a giant meat grinder. Anyone who approached an ocean universe would be instantly vaporized.

In the end, the giant dragon head opened its mouth and bit down on the spaceship.

“Boom!”

An earth-shattering explosion shook the entire universe.

A terrifying energy wave spread out like a wave.

The entire void was lit up.

After a long time, the light slowly disappeared.

At this moment, how could there still be an ocean universe army in the void?

What spaceship?

There was only a deathly silent black hole that was tens of thousands of miles wide.

An aura that made one’s scalp tingle spread in all directions.

At the same time, a series of notifications rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Killed King Stage Level 1 cultivator. Obtained 1 billion experience points.]

[Ding! Killed King Stage Level 2 cultivator. Obtained 2 billion experience points.]

[Ding! Killed a King Stage Level 3 cultivator. Obtained 3 billion experience points.]

[Ding! Killed a King Stage Level 4 cultivator. Obtained 4 billion experience points.]

….

A tsunami of energy surged into Lin Fan’s body.

He felt extremely comfortable, warm, and full of strength.

Not long after, Lin Fan’s mind rang out with a notification.

[Ding! [Congratulations, your cultivation has reached King Level 9.]]

With Lin Fan as the center, a vast aura spread out in all directions, forming a strong gale in the void.

Murder… Had he broken through?

This feeling was not bad!

Lin Fan’s lips curled up.

He looked around.

This glance was very calm.

However, the powerful beings who had come along with the Grand Elder to help Lin Fan deal with the ocean universe army were all trembling in fear.

The power that Lin Fan had displayed was simply too powerful and terrifying.

When they faced Lin Fan, they felt like ants.

Terrifying!

This was a fear that came from the bottom of his heart.

If Lin Fan wanted to attack them, they wouldn’t be able to resist or escape.

However, Lin Fan didn’t have such thoughts.

At this moment, a series of notifications kept ringing in his mind.

[Ding! Qin Xian has a favorable impression of you. Favorability is 6 stars.]

[Ding! [You have gained a favorable impression of McKai. Favorability is 5 stars.]]

[Ding! [Liu Zhengdong has a favorable impression of you. Favorability is 5 stars.]]

[Ding! [Mai Wu has developed a favorable impression of you. Favorability is 5 stars.]]

….

Everyone had a good impression of Lin Fan. Furthermore, they were here to help.

Therefore, Lin Fan did not make things difficult for them. Stepping out, he disappeared from where he was.

“Phew!”

Seeing this…

The Four Seasons Universe experts all heaved a long sigh of relief.

At this moment, they realized that their bodies were drenched in sweat.

It was as if he had walked around hell.

They looked at each other and muttered,”We… Survived?”

“Alive.”

“This…”

“What exactly…”

Their language became a little lacking. When their gazes fell on the giant black hole in front of them again, their scalps went numb, and they could not help but swallow their saliva.

Then, like a frightened bird, he fled into the distant void.

….

At this moment, Lin Fan had already returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa on Earth.

Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others looked over with concern.

Obviously, they had also felt the attack on Earth.

Lin Fan smiled,” Don’t worry, it’s fine.””

When everyone heard Lin Fan’s voice, they heaved a sigh of relief and asked.

“Lin Fan, what happened outside just now?”

Lin Fan said,” It’s just some weak people who have designs on Earth. However, I have already taught them a lesson. They won’t come again.””

Some weak people?

The many marine universe armies, and even the marine universe masters, were considered weak?

As for not coming back?

Of course not.

After all, they had all turned into ashes.

When the girls heard this, they secretly decided that they must cultivate well.

In the future, he would be able to fend off troubles with Lin Fan.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s smile suddenly stopped.

That was because another notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Bo Han has hatred towards you, Hatred Points: 5 stars.]

5 stars of aggro?

Lin Fan frowned.

[Bo Han: Cultivation unknown. Because you killed the ocean universe master and annihilated the ocean universe army, hatred has been generated against you. Current Hatred Points: 5 stars.]

Lin Fan frowned even harder.

Cultivation unknown?

That was very likely to be a Holy Lord!

This was really hitting the small one, and the old one came?

He still had Sacred Lord Tai Ba to deal with, and now there was another Sacred Lord Bo Han?

After killing so many enemies, Lin Fan’s cultivation state had increased by another level. This gave Lin Fan the urge to relax for a while.

At this moment, he directly threw this thought to the back of his mind.

Cultivation!

He had to seize the time to cultivate!

Otherwise, if Tai Ba and Bo Han each called eight or ten Saint Sovereigns over and attacked Earth for a few hundred years, wouldn’t he be unable to defend?

Hence, after Lin Fan gave Hu Tian, Xia Bing, Xia Xue and the rest some instructions, he returned to his room and prepared to enter the state of cultivation.

And before he started cultivating, Lin Fan tried to soothe his anxious mood by giving Tai Ba a set of curses.

As for Bo Han, he had to wait.

Otherwise, Lin Fan was worried that the matter of him cursing someone would be known by others.
